subgroup_rule: Count every affine point plus O exactly; largest prime r>=5 with valuation one in #E, then lex first nonzero exact-order-r P. Explicit r11 required for pairing. No qualifying r => inadmissible cell retained, never replaced.

factorbase.target_law: all G targets including O for oracle; separate affine targets for polynomial interfaces
factorbase.coset_schedule: Every rational finite nonkernel coset, represented by lex first A in its rational fiber, for each d0..3; exact full rational-fiber census, no postselection. Report original first-coset slice separately. Preserve empty target bases and duplicate actual-base histograms with correct denominator.

tuple_convention: Ordered tuples with replacement; base excludes O, target ranges over all G including O. Keep every target count and zero case.
basis_convention: Fp elements canonical integers0..p-1; F25 pairs(c0,c1) encode c0+c1*z; O sorts before affine points.
blind_scope: Definitions and fixtures only. No producer observation, expected derived group order, kernel/fiber/base/tuple count, lambda or cost is included.
